events.title: The Agentic Enterprise: From Intelligence to Trusted Action
events.description:
Agentic AI is shifting how we work and redefining our roles. Agents are moving from answering questions to understanding, reasoning, and acting alongside people. As intelligence becomes abundant, the new leadership questions are: how can you uniquely and durably unlock value with AI, and build reliable agentic systems at scale?

[Sagar Murthy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sagar-murthy-13064a8/), AI GTM & Strategic Partnerships with AWS will unpack the state of agentic AI, the emerging patterns, and real production deployment outcomes. You will leave with a practical framework to take your agentic systems from pilot to production, with trusted governance and grounded in compounding durable advantage: your data, context, and workflows that are uniquely yours.

Agenda:
8:30 - 8:45 Networking
8:45 - 9:45 Presentation & Open Q&A
9:45 - 10:15 Round Table Discussion
10:15 - 10:30 Networking
